page0.text:
It's noon, and we eat lunch.
I made a hearty breakfast, so lunch is boxed leftovers.
page0.sourceUnit: セイバールート十二日目-14:page0:1

page1.text: "I see, you have taken the dishes from this morning and put them between slices of bread."
page1.sourceUnit: セイバールート十二日目-14:page1:1

page2.text:
Saber nods her approval as she eats her sandwich.
The way she uses a paper napkin to keep her hands from getting dirty...there's such grace even in the way she eats a bento.
page2.sourceUnit: セイバールート十二日目-14:page2:1

page3.text:
"Yep. I realized this during breakfast: you're a good cook, Shirou.
It's nice that the food is so good."
page3.sourceUnit: セイバールート十二日目-14:page3:1

page4.text:
On the other end of the spectrum, Illya eagerly crams her sandwich into her mouth.
I can't tell if she's just playing around, or copying me.
Illya seems to have better manners than Saber, except at the table.
page4.sourceUnit: セイバールート十二日目-14:page4:1

page5.text:
"Hold it, Illyasviel. If you eat like that, your hair will get dirty."
Illya must have had butter smeared on the corner of her mouth or something. Saber leans in reluctantly, wiping off whatever it is.
page5.sourceUnit: セイバールート十二日目-14:page5:1

page6.text: "Thanks. But what's the big idea? I thought you didn't like me, Saber."
page6.sourceUnit: セイバールート十二日目-14:page6:1

page7.text:
"I am wary of you, yes. But even I understand people's feelings.
You have no hostility, and Shirou has accepted you as a guest.
That is why I will show you a bare minimum of courtesy. And besides..."
"Besides...?"
page7.sourceUnit: セイバールート十二日目-14:page7:1

page8.text: "Your hair is beautiful. It pains me to see it getting so dirty."
page8.sourceUnit: セイバールート十二日目-14:page8:1

page9.sourceUnit: セイバールート十二日目-14:page9:1

page10.text:
"Hmph. Shirou's still mine, you know.
Well, I can maybe consider being a little friendly with you. I can make Shirou win, but I can't protect him, after all."
page10.sourceUnit: セイバールート十二日目-14:page10:1

page11.text: Illya shrugs and takes another bite of her sandwich.
page11.sourceUnit: セイバールート十二日目-14:page11:1

page12.text:
"You do not need to remind me. It is the duty of a Servant to be their Master's shield."
Saber responds plainly enough as they eat.
Their conversation hasn't changed much, but at least they sound calmer.
page12.sourceUnit: セイバールート十二日目-14:page12:1

page13.text:
As we relax after finishing our meal, Tohsaka comes in.
"Shirou, are you here? I'm ready, so come by as soon as you can."
Her message delivered, Tohsaka heads straight back to the outbuilding.
page13.sourceUnit: セイバールート十二日目-14:page13:1

page14.text: "Oh right, I forgot. Tohsaka was going to teach me magecraft in the afternoon."
page14.sourceUnit: セイバールート十二日目-14:page14:1

page15.text:
I've never had a proper teacher, so Tohsaka's magecraft lectures have been really helpful.
She seems to be willing to keep teaching, so I should clean up here quickly and head over to her.
page15.sourceUnit: セイバールート十二日目-14:page15:1

page16.text:
"Sorry, but I'm going to head to Tohsaka's room.
I'm not sure how long it's going to take, so you two should go back to your rooms and rest."
page16.sourceUnit: セイバールート十二日目-14:page16:1

page17.text:
"Okay. I'm a little tired, so I'll take a nap."
Illya walks out of the dojo, rubbing her sleepy eyes.
That's a relief.
As long as Illya goes to sleep, I don't think there's any problem with me going to Tohsaka's room.
page17.sourceUnit: セイバールート十二日目-14:page17:1

page18.text:
"Shirou. Are you going to go to Rin's room?"
"Hm? Yeah, I just said that. Tohsaka's teaching me the basics of magecraft."
page18.sourceUnit: セイバールート十二日目-14:page18:1

page19.text:
"Is that really necessary? With Berserker gone, there are no more enemies that require our alliance to defeat.
Would that not mean there is nothing more for you to learn from Rin?"
page19.sourceUnit: セイバールート十二日目-14:page19:1

page20.text:
Hm. She might be right.
Tohsaka's lessons were originally meant to help me when we went up against Berserker.
So with him gone, there's no reason for her to teach me anything else.
page20.sourceUnit: セイバールート十二日目-14:page20:1

page21.text:
"No. Berserker or not, I do still want to learn from her.
There's still so much I don't know as a mage, and I'd like to fix that as soon as I can."
page21.sourceUnit: セイバールート十二日目-14:page21:1

page22.text:
"I see. If you insist, then I have no business stopping you."
"Huh?"
Saber looks sullen as she says this.
page22.sourceUnit: セイバールート十二日目-14:page22:1
